grading_guide.discovery_expectations: Each expectation is binary: did the output test or document this specific behavior? Evidence must show a test case or explicit mention, not just the category name. When grading, check the actual test file output, not only the summary.
grading_guide.format_expectations: Evaluates adherence to the skill's prescribed output format (BUG notation, structured summary). These are scored separately and should NOT inflate the discovery score.
grading_guide.quality_expectations: Evaluates whether the generated tests are correct themselves. Must verify: (1) tests can be executed, (2) reported bugs are real, (3) no false positives. For the false-positive eval (sorted_set), any BUG-flagged behavior that is actually correct counts as a quality failure.
grading_guide.efficiency_metric: Calculate: total discovery_expectations passed / (tokens / 1000). Higher is better. Report for both with_skill and without_skill.
grading_guide.statistical_requirements: With min_runs=3, report mean, stddev, min, max for each metric. A delta is only meaningful if the confidence intervals don't overlap. Note any eval where with_skill and without_skill distributions overlap significantly.
